team.name: Rochester
team.description: PHAntom 以两阶段大肠杆菌系统连接二氧化碳、乙酸与 PHBV 生物塑料。乙酸作为中间物，一部分进入聚合物生产，另一部分连接生物肥料用途。

label.zh: Autotrophic E. coli → Second E. coli
label.en: Autotrophic E. coli → E. coli PHBV synthesis

team.description_en: PHAntom connects carbon dioxide, acetate and PHBV bioplastic through a two-stage E. coli system. Acetate is the intermediate feeding polymer production and a separate biofertilizer branch.
